candidates.title: Scheduled publication becomes visible at its scheduled time
candidates.preconditions: A page with a future publish date; isolated clock-controlled fixture or bounded wait; no existing page with same slug.
candidates.fixture: Create a published page with a future date; observe its scheduled state, then observe after the due time.

oracle.observable: Before due time page is absent from public published-page list; after due time it is present and scheduler indicator/state is cleared.

novelty.rationale: Potentially distinct from BL-017 change-post-date; that baseline case changes the date but does not specify the scheduler transition. Novelty remains unverified.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Potentially distinct from BL-017 change-post-date; that baseline case changes the date but does not specify the scheduler transition. Novelty remains unverified.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Repeat with a future-dated draft; it must remain unpublished.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Clock control/scheduler cadence may be unavailable; no live runtime check was performed.
candidates.uncertainty: Source confirms future date maps published to scheduled and scheduler rule exists; end-to-end transition and oracle need runtime/reviewer validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Scheduled publication becomes visible at its scheduled time.

candidates.title: Cover image selection persists and renders for content
candidates.preconditions: Use a small synthetic PNG in the app-managed images area; choose a unique content slug.
candidates.fixture: Select a local cover image while editing content, save, reload and open the public content page.

oracle.observable: Saved content references the selected image and the public page resolves that image in its cover slot.

novelty.rationale: Potential gap beyond generic add-content; baseline content creation does not state a cover-image persistence/render oracle.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Potential gap beyond generic add-content; baseline content creation does not state a cover-image persistence/render oracle.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Save without a cover image and verify no broken/placeholder URL is emitted.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Theme-specific rendering and image cleanup may affect reproducibility.
candidates.uncertainty: Model stores coverImage; edit view exposes the Images tab. Theme-level public rendering must be confirmed.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Cover image selection persists and renders for content.

candidates.title: Static page and post have distinct public placement
candidates.preconditions: Fresh static page and post with unique slugs; public home page is available.
candidates.fixture: Create one page and one post using the two content types, then inspect public navigation/list and direct URLs.

oracle.observable: Both records persist their type; the post appears in post listing while the static page is addressable as a page without being treated as a post.

novelty.rationale: Baseline add-content, parent and URL cases cover content fields/relationships but do not assert page-versus-post placement.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline add-content, parent and URL cases cover content fields/relationships but do not assert page-versus-post placement.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Compare with a normal post under the same category/route context.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Theme templates may alter listing placement; avoid assuming a particular menu entry.
candidates.uncertainty: Source model has an explicit `post`/`page` type field; public behavior needs theme-specific confirmation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Static page and post have distinct public placement.

candidates.title: Administrator can change a non-admin user's role and retain it
candidates.preconditions: Seed a second non-admin user and record their current role; use synthetic credentials.
candidates.fixture: Change the user's role to Administrator, save, reload the edit form, then log in with the seeded account.

oracle.observable: Persisted role is Administrator after reload and account permission reflects that role on an admin-only route.

novelty.rationale: Baseline add/delete user and password cases do not assert role editing or role-specific access.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline add/delete user and password cases do not assert role editing or role-specific access.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Attempt the same role change while signed in as Editor; save must not grant elevated access.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Authorization may be enforced in controller/router outside the inspected form; treat route denial as an uncertainty until traced.
candidates.uncertainty: View exposes role selector only for an Administrator; role persistence and privilege effect need validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Administrator can change a non-admin user's role and retain it.
